name: agent-cli-linked-order-groups-with-exposure-cea5
instr:
Let callers execute an ordered set of related strategy decisions as one exposure-aware operation with a stable identity and policy-controlled recovery from asymmetric fills. Group identity must survive routing, execution, accounting, persistence, restart, and session completion. Existing ungrouped trading behavior remains unchanged.

Invalid groups raise `InvalidOrderGroup` from `common.order_groups` before placement, cancellation, reservation, or persistence becomes observable. `route_group(self, group, snapshots)` preserves leg order and identity while rejecting indefinitely resting compensation routes and unsupported maker-only instructions. `submit_group(self, group, snapshots)` reserves worst-case exposure before placement and returns deterministic per-leg evidence and a policy-correct group outcome, including visible unresolved exposure after failed or declined compensation. Original fills advance capped parent progress once, compensation is accounted separately, and both affect agent and house inventory before risk release or terminal publication. `record_group_fill(self, result, timestamp_ms)` records accepted transitions durably and idempotently in append order. `GroupJournal` from `parent.store`, through `load(self)`, preserves complete records despite a truncated tail, while `restore_groups(self, transitions)` resumes only unfinished work without replaying completed fills. `group_snapshot(self, group_id)` exposes state consistent with positions, reservations, TWAP
